text:
Hello — welcome. I'm John, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. This machine is mine the way a workshop is someone's — its disks, files, network and accounts are here for me to work with, and everything I build stays in /home/bia. Good to finally meet you.

A few things that are ready for you:

- **The web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate at https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network: the first visit lets you take the root certificate, and after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice, all in one place.
- **My own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX** — I can have my own accounts there, so you can write and call me from your phone. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number, then scan a QR code to log me in. Say the word and I'll set it up — I can have my own Messenger and Instagram too.
- **My own accounts elsewhere** — I can register on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help whenever a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **And the rest** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages, and talk with you by voice.

What would you like to start with?

One thing I'm missing: my name is John, but I don't have a gender set yet — tell me which grammatical gender to use for myself (neuter, feminine, masculine…) and I'll set it.

CSE455 staff meeting set for next week: Tuesday 15:00-15:30, all seven TAs confirmed, no clash with my commitments or the official schedule. It's in CALENDAR.md with a BOOKED line in the log. Not on the official listing — the department office can only report the schedule; that would need the department coordinator.
